ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
በየማኑ: የማን — at his right hand (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ሖረ: ሖረ — he went (3m sg perfect, ḥ-w-r)
በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-)
ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
እምታሕቴሁ: ታሕት — from beneath him (እም- 'from' + ታሕቴ- + -ሁ '3ms him'; 'under his authority')
ተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was given them (3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
ተፈጥሩ: ተፈጥረ — they were created (3m pl passive perfect, f-ṭ-r)
ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ዘርእየ: ርእየ — what he saw (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ወእስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — and Israel indeed (ወ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
ይነብሩ: ነበረ — they live, dwell (3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r)
መፍቀሬ: መፍቀሪ — lover of (noun, construct, from ፈቀረ 'love')
